title: Curving Shore
description: A wide sandy beach curves toward a palm-lined shore in Bahia, Brazil, with small waves breaking under a mostly blue sky and a large white cloud on the horizon.

title: The Quiraing
description: An aerial view of the jagged green peaks of the Quiraing on the Isle of Skye, with a narrow road winding through the hills below a heavy, rain-laden sky.
location: The Quiraing, Isle of Skye, Scotland

title: High Alpine Ridges
description: Green and grey mountain ridges of the Lechtal Alps in Austria, with patches of old snow on a distant peak and hazy summits fading into the background under a clear sky.

title: Distant Tower
description: A hazy view over Taipei's skyline, with Taipei 101 rising above the city and mountains behind, framed by green foliage in the foreground.

title: Straight Desert Road
description: A straight two-lane highway runs to a vanishing point toward the distant buttes and mesas of Monument Valley, seen from Forrest Gump Point, Utah, under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

title: Evening over the Cove
description: A rocky cove near Benidorm, Spain, with a small island offshore as the sun sets low over the sea.

title: Mineral Ridges
description: Striped ridges of turquoise, gold, red, and purple earth rise above a walking trail under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

title: Machu Picchu
description: Stone ruins and terraced green lawns sit on a high mountain ridge beneath steep peaks draped in low clouds.

title: Coastal Bluffs
description: Ocean waves wash against a long sandy beach bordered by eroded bluffs and a distant coastal hillside.

title: Glacier Flow
description: A vast expanse of textured blue glacial ice wraps around dark rocky ridges into a milky lake under an overcast sky.
location: Torres del Paine National Park, Chile

title: Perito Moreno
description: A massive wall of fractured blue glacier ice terminates in a calm lake below snow-streaked mountain peaks.

title: Through the Mist
description: Massive waterfalls pour over lush green cliffs into a canyon filled with dense rising spray.

title: Scalloped Shore
description: An elevated view of Praia do Norte in Nazaré, Portugal, where white waves fold onto a wide stretch of pale sand and two small figures walk near the water's edge.

title: Palms at Dusk
description: Tall palm trees stand in silhouette against an orange and grey sunset sky in San Diego, California.

title: Palms in the Breeze
description: A leaning coconut palm frames a view of pale turquoise water and distant boats on Koh Phangan, Thailand.

title: Looking Up
description: Cherry blossom branches in full pink bloom against a clear blue sky in Böblingen, Germany.

title: Storm Clouds
description: Dark storm clouds gather over red sandstone rock formations rising above sagebrush in Arches National Park, Utah.

title: Golden Gate
description: The Golden Gate Bridge spans the bay under a clear sky, with the San Francisco skyline visible across the water.

title: Sugarloaf
description: An aerial view over Rio de Janeiro's dense waterfront neighborhoods to Sugarloaf Mountain and Guanabara Bay, with distant hills fading into haze and cloud.

title: White Frangipani
description: Clusters of white frangipani flowers with yellow centres on a tree against a clear blue sky in Koh Samui, Thailand.

title: Palm Fronds
description: Close view of arching palm fronds in San Diego, California, their green blades shading to yellow and pale cream where sunlight falls across them.

title: Last Light
description: A lone figure stands on the wet sand as the sun sets low over the ocean at Sagres, Portugal, its light forming a bright path across rows of incoming waves.

title: The Cliff Edge
description: An aerial view of waves breaking against a rocky cliff base and a small pocket beach at Uluwatu, Bali, with two surfers waiting beyond the break.

title: One Branch
description: Pale pink cherry blossoms open along a dark branch, photographed close up in Böblingen, Germany, with more blossoms and buds blurred behind.

title: Batok at Sunrise
description: Sunrise light rakes the volcanic cones of the Tengger caldera at Bromo, Java, with the conical peak of Mount Semeru rising in the distance.

title: Pink Frangipani
description: A cluster of pink frangipani flowers with green leaves against a clear blue sky in Bali, Indonesia.

title: Low Tide
description: The sun sets over the Atlantic at Vila Nova de Milfontes, Portugal, its light spreading orange across the sky and reflecting on wet rock pools and exposed reef in the foreground, with birds gathered along the shoreline.

title: Tide Lines
description: An aerial view of a wave breaking, white foam streaking across the teal ocean surface off Bali, Indonesia.
